name: Seeva AI Assistant
headline: Seeva AI Assistant - AI Overlay for Quick Access
short_description: AI overlay for quick access to AI assistance. Press a key, ask AI, get back to work. Works on macOS, Windows, and Linux. Integrates with Claude. Open-source and customizable.
author: thisisharsh7

sections.overview:
Seeva is an open-source AI overlay that eliminates tab-switching by bringing AI assistance directly to your screen. Press Ctrl+Shift+Space from any application—fullscreen apps, code editors, browsers, or games—and an AI assistant appears as an overlay. It can capture and analyze your screen context, detect which app you're using, and integrates with Claude, GPT, or OpenRouter. All conversations save locally in SQLite with no cloud storage or telemetry. Built with Tauri and React, it's designed for developers and professionals who need quick AI help without interrupting their workflow.
Quick coding questions while working in VS Code or other editors
Screen analysis: ask AI about what you're viewing without describing it
Context-aware assistance based on detected app and screen content
Accessing multiple AI providers (Claude, GPT, OpenRouter) from one overlay
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/thisisharsh7/seeva-ai-assistant`
sections.usage:
```
Act as my Seeva AI assistant. I'm working on [PROJECT] for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. I need help with [TASK]. Provide a concise, actionable solution using the following [DATA] or context: [CONTEXT]. Keep responses under 200 words and formatted for quick scanning.
```
Copy

```
# Quick AI Assistance for Project X

**Task:** Draft email to stakeholders about Q3 performance

**Key Points:**
- Q3 revenue up 15% YoY
- Market share increased by 2.3%
- Challenges: Supply chain delays

**Draft Email:**

Subject: Q3 Performance Update & Key Insights

Dear Team,

I'm pleased to share that our Q3 performance exceeded expectations with a 15% YoY revenue increase and a 2.3% market share gain. These results reflect our team's hard work and strategic initiatives.

However, we faced challenges with supply chain delays, which impacted our ability to meet some customer demands. We're actively working on solutions to mitigate these issues moving forward.

I'll provide more details in our upcoming review. Thank you for your continued dedication and collaboration.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
